main_topics.reason: The user came to check whether a different maker's version of the same dose was something to worry about and asked what to do.
The user asked why to wait six to eight weeks, whether a recent TSH result counted, and when to test again.
The user said they would prefer to stay on one brand and discussed asking the doctor and pharmacy about this.
The user said they notice coldness and tiredness quickly and would watch for them while waiting for the test.
The user briefly said they were annoyed that the pharmacy switched the brand without explaining the change.

output.summary: The user asked whether a pharmacy substitution of a different maker's levothyroxine required action, and asked about TSH timing, symptoms to watch for, and keeping the same routine. The assistant advised a new TSH check six to eight weeks after the switch and suggested discussing brand consistency with the doctor and pharmacy; the user said the plan was clear and exactly the straight answer they wanted.
